faq.headline: Frequently asked questions about contact and process

items.question: What is the fastest way to reach mmoving.de?
items.answer: The callback form on this page. You pick a preferred time — including “as soon as possible” — and we call you back. For instant answers about services and processes, the chat assistant is available around the clock, including by voice.

items.question: What does a consultation or quote cost?
items.answer: Advice and quotes are free and without obligation. Only the inspection service for property buyers is a separate service at a flat fee of €290.

items.question: Does the survey have to be on site?
items.answer: Not necessarily. For a manageable scope a survey by photo or video is enough. For larger flats, houses and combined jobs we recommend an on-site appointment, because the volume estimate is far more accurate.

items.question: What radius do you cover?
items.answer: Munich and roughly 50 km around it, including Dachau, Freising, Erding, Ebersberg, Starnberg, Fürstenfeldbruck and the entire Munich district. For addresses outside that, just ask — we assess feasibility case by case.

items.question: Do you speak English?
items.answer: Yes. Advice, quoting and delivery are available in German and English. You can reach the English version of this site via the language switch at the top.

items.question: When are you available?
items.answer: Monday to Friday from 8am to 6pm and Saturdays from 9am to 2pm. Callback and chat requests can be submitted around the clock — we respond at the next available time.

items.question: What happens after my enquiry?
items.answer: We call back at your chosen time and clarify the scope. A survey follows on site or by video, after which you receive a written fixed-price quote with a date. Only then do you decide.

items.question: What happens to the data from the form?
items.answer: Your details are used solely to process your enquiry and are sent to our team by email. Nothing is passed on for advertising purposes. Details are in our privacy policy.
